record.hypothesis: Across all four categories, scale visible input vectors by 1+0.04*tanh(z), with z the standardized log1p training-item count; checkpoint these statistics and keep mask scale one. Under embedding representation, retain tied normalized rows but multiply their radius by 0.8. Under learning objective, divide masked-item CE logits by temperature 0.8. Under hyperparameter tuning, set LR=7e-4 and dropout=0.1. The smaller radius softens context identity, temperature compensates output scale, and frequency cues plus lower dropout preserve useful context distinctions. Keep the bidirectional backbone, length 128, one checkpoint/category and matching predictor writer; retain seed 42 and 200 epochs/200 batches.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four datasets, jointly lower learning rate to 7e-4 and dropout to 0.1 to support the smaller embedding radius and mild frequency cue. Preserve length 128, seed, epoch cap and batches per epoch; enforce the required data-directory binding.
Use temperature 0.8 for masked-item cross-entropy, compensating for the reduced tied output embedding radius while retaining the existing masked targets and full real-item catalog.

Scale visible item inputs by 1+0.04*tanh(z), using standardized log1p counts from training interactions only. Padding and mask scales remain one. A persistent buffer checkpoints the feature values; the existing predictor writer imports this same model class and loads the buffer with its single category checkpoint.

Retain tied normalized item embeddings and multiply their radius by 0.8. This softens context identity and couples with the loss temperature; the shared model class keeps training and generated prediction consistent.
